Great rooftop restaurant and bar
Jun 2026 • Solo
I visited Mit twice during my stay in Ho Chi Minh - my Intrepid tour guide (Mahn) took us there for a group dinner and I enjoyed it so much i returned solo after the tour. Lovely outdoor setting, great food and cocktails. Very reasonably priced. It can be a little tricky to find the entrance at first but just ask the friendly old security men out the front of the buildings and they will show you up.
Highly recommend
